page_title: BOL 1-1 SAS | Bologna v Sassuolo 28/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+2' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' It's time for a substitution. Walid Cheddira (Sassuolo) comes on in place of Armand Lauriente.
88' Vincenzo Italiano prepares a substitution. Nadir Zortea is replaced by Emil Holm (Bologna).
88' Fine play by Nikola Moro (Bologna) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles past the right post.
87' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) has tested the patience of referee Juan Luca Sacchi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
84' Jonathan Rowe will be replaced by Jens Odgaard (Bologna).
82' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
79' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

79' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Federico Ravaglia sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner.
76' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes high over the bar.
74' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
74' Juan Miranda (Bologna) will take a corner kick.
71' A substitution has been made. Cristian Volpato is replaced by Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo).
70' We are about to witness a substitution. Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) is replacing Riccardo Orsolini.
70' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ciro Immobile (Bologna) replacing Giovanni Fabbian.
70' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Thijs Dallinga walks off the pitch to be replaced by Santiago Castro (Bologna).

68' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Federico Ravaglia anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
67' A snap shot by Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) from the edge of the area flies towards the left side of the goal, but Arijanet Muric produces a good save to thwart him.

63' 1 - 1 The ball was swung towards the box by Armand Lauriente from the corner kick. He perfectly found the head of Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo), who planted a long-range header down inside the right post to make the score 1:1.
63' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Josh Doig (Sassuolo) replaces Fali Cande.
57' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Arijanet Muric as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
52' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
47' 1 - 0 Goal! Nadir Zortea plays it to Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Arijanet Muric. 1:0.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Federico Ravaglia (Bologna) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
45' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
44' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
39' Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post.
33' Arijanet Muric pulls off a great save to deny Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal.
31' Sassuolo quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
30' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Federico Ravaglia easily deals with the threat.
29' Nadir Zortea (Bologna) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well over the bar.
26' Juan Miranda (Bologna) meets a cross from the flank and pulls the trigger from the edge of the box, but the ball flies high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
25' Nikola Moro (Bologna) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
25' Tarik Muharemovic (Sassuolo) jumps into a tackle and Juan Luca Sacchi signals a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Bologna.
22' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
21' Fali Cande (Sassuolo) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
20' The corner from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is intercepted by the defence.

20' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. Federico Ravaglia has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save. Sassuolo have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
17' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) sends a chip pass into the box, but Arijanet Muric is quickest to intercept the ball.
9' Nikola Moro (Bologna) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
8' Nadir Zortea (Bologna) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. Good work from Bologna as they win a corner.
7' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Juan Luca Sacchi who sees an offensive foul.
5' The linesman signals that Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Sassuolo will take the kick-off.
Juan Luca Sacchi got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
